rationale: Class (a). The untracked parent copy of the AISDLC-948 task file was byte-identical to the one on branch ai-sdlc/file-aisdlc-948 (PR 1687), so the planner removed the parent copy; the branch and PR are untouched. Root cause: cli-file leaves the untracked source file in the parent after filing, and Step 0.5 then tries to re-file it under the same branch name. Candidate fix: cli-file removes (or git-stashes) the source once the branch is pushed.
